name: s81hc_ctrnpar_w_ref
why_floorplan: Stacked split of the ctrn_col_w return slice (10-16 a5): ctrn_col a3 (144.18x25.92, 1,140 b) failed GRT-0116 only in the N-face output band (10.5 pins/um: output flop + hold stage per bit in the top ~4 um; M3/M5 1-4 tracks over, usage 23-25%); a4 at 34.56 still shows the band red at the gate. Split: partner 512 b per 144.18x25.92 leaf, ~5 pins/um per face, same x per bit; partner leaf directly S of the own leaf (toward the ret row).

job.purpose: cth_ntc return slice, stacked split (retrow CTRN_SPLIT 1): partner leaf S: partner a/b payload, 512 b, plain registers
job.hold_merge: cth_ntc parent component: the parent kit binds it after every child closes with native PASS; exactness = two-row chain proof + exact HC gate (RETCOL)

pin_regs.reason: Real RTL registers the boundary at its own stage (chain rd/rv -> rdq/rvq, y beat / cs relays, ybuf / psb captures, rdm / header / request / flag registers); a generic pin register would add a cycle to the fixed return calendar. hrq feeds the same-cycle merge (bank round trip) by design.

structural_change: ctrn_col_{e,w} (one register, 1,140 b) split into ctrn_own (rv/flag merge/hdr/own a,b) + ctrn_par (partner a,b): identical registers, reset and flag merge (ot_s81_hc_ctrn_own / ot_s81_hc_ctrn_par, retrow CTRN_SPLIT 1), 0 cycles. Parent cth_ntc 874.26 -> 900.18 (slice row 51.84); rows below keep their distance from the tile bottom; chain legs +25.92 (max 488.3 um), to_slice max 346.4, partner legs unchanged (623.4).
slot_change_request: New cth_ntc leaf (top-down parent plan tools/s81/hc_cthntc_plan.py --split, physical/s81_die_pins/v28_hc_cthntc_split: 10-16 a5: parent 576.72 x 900.18).
